Properties.Title: Comment
Properties.Tooltip: Free-form note for authors. HT5 preserves it with the event; it does not control audio playback.

Properties.Title: Type
Properties.Tooltip: Selects the sound-event operator stack or implementation. Common CS2 types include csgo_mega for spatial events and csgo_music for music playback.

Properties.Title: Base
Properties.Tooltip: Inherit properties from another sound event, then override them with values defined on this event.

Properties.Title: Metadata
Properties.Tooltip: Engine/tool metadata tags attached to the sound event. The string format is engine-specific; shipped examples include mediumfs 1000 and quietfs 600.

Properties.Title: Value
Properties.Tooltip: Generic numeric value used by setter-style sound-event stacks. Its exact meaning depends on the event Type.

Properties.Title: Vsnd Duration
Properties.Tooltip: Cached duration of the referenced VSND in seconds. Usually generated by tools and normally not something to tune by hand.

Properties.Title: Volume
Properties.Tooltip: Base playback volume. Random offsets, curves, mixgroup gain and volume convars can modify the final level.

Properties.Title: Volume Random Min
Properties.Tooltip: Minimum random offset added to the base volume each time a track is selected.

Properties.Title: Volume Random Max
Properties.Tooltip: Maximum random offset added to the base volume each time a track is selected.

Properties.Title: Pitch
Properties.Tooltip: Base playback-rate multiplier. 1.0 is normal pitch and speed; random pitch offsets can be added to it.

Properties.Title: Pitch Random Min
Properties.Tooltip: Minimum random offset added to the base pitch each time a track is selected.

Properties.Title: Pitch Random Max
Properties.Tooltip: Maximum random offset added to the base pitch each time a track is selected.

Properties.Title: Delay
Properties.Tooltip: Delay in seconds before the event starts playing.

Properties.Title: Priority
Properties.Tooltip: Priority used when a CS:GO music track competes in the music track queue. Higher-priority tracks can win over lower ones.

Properties.Title: Ducking Bypass
Properties.Tooltip: Blends the event toward the ducking-bypass routing path so it can avoid normal ducking.

Properties.Title: Preload Vsnds
Properties.Tooltip: Request the referenced VSND assets be preloaded so first playback does not have to load them on demand.

Properties.Title: Vsnd Pause With Game
Properties.Tooltip: Pause the VSND voice when the game is paused.

Properties.Title: Is Ui Sound
Properties.Tooltip: Treat the event as a UI/local sound for positioning and routing decisions.

Properties.Title: Voice Culling Threshold
Properties.Tooltip: Volume threshold below which the engine can cull an inaudible voice to reduce processing cost.

Properties.Title: Use Fadetime Volume Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Enable the fade-time-to-volume curve used while the event is stopping or fading.

Properties.Title: Fadetime Volume Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Maps stop or fade elapsed time to a volume multiplier.

Properties.Title: Volume Fade Out Input Max
Properties.Tooltip: Duration, in seconds, of the CS:GO music stop fade.

Properties.Title: Volume Fade Initial Input Min
Properties.Tooltip: Start of the elapsed-time range used by the CS:GO music initial-volume remap.

Properties.Title: Volume Fade Initial Input Max
Properties.Tooltip: End of the elapsed-time range used by the CS:GO music initial-volume remap.

Properties.Title: Volume Fade Initial Input Map Min
Properties.Tooltip: Output gain produced at the start of the CS:GO music initial-volume remap.

Properties.Title: Volume Fade Initial Input Map Max
Properties.Tooltip: Output gain produced at the end of the CS:GO music initial-volume remap.

Properties.Title: Position
Properties.Tooltip: Authored world position for the sound event. [0, 0, 0] is commonly a placeholder when the caller or entity supplies the real position.

Properties.Title: Position Offset
Properties.Tooltip: Offset added to the sound source position before spatialization.

Properties.Title: Position Offset Relative
Properties.Tooltip: Rotate or orient Position Offset relative to the source entity before applying it.

Properties.Title: Use World Position
Properties.Tooltip: Tell the sound stack to use the authored or world-position path for source placement.

Properties.Title: Use Uiposition
Properties.Tooltip: Enable listener-relative positioning using a UI-position vector expressed along the listener left, forward and up axes.

Properties.Title: Position Relative To Player
Properties.Tooltip: Use the listener/player position as the base source position instead of the source entity or authored world position.

Properties.Title: Use Entity Position If Local Player
Properties.Tooltip: If the source is the local player, use the source entity position for spatial placement.

Properties.Title: Set Child Position
Properties.Tooltip: Pass the parent event position to child sound events so they play from the same source.

Properties.Title: Randomize Position Min Radius
Properties.Tooltip: Minimum radius, in Source units, for the random position offset generated when the event starts.

Properties.Title: Randomize Position Max Radius
Properties.Tooltip: Maximum radius, in Source units, for the random position offset generated when the event starts.

Properties.Title: Randomize Position Hemisphere
Properties.Tooltip: Limit the random position offset to the positive-Z hemisphere instead of a full sphere.

Properties.Title: Distance Multiplier
Properties.Tooltip: Multiplier applied to listener distance before distance-based curves are evaluated.

Properties.Title: Broadcast Distance Override
Properties.Tooltip: Override the distance used by the event broadcast or observer propagation path.

Properties.Title: Display Broadcast
Properties.Tooltip: Enable CS2 broadcast or observer-oriented sound propagation behavior for this event.

Properties.Title: Use Distance Volume Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Enable the distance-to-volume curve for attenuation.

Properties.Title: Distance Volume Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Maps listener distance, after Distance Multiplier, to a volume multiplier.

Properties.Title: Use Distance Unfiltered Stereo Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Enable the distance-based curve that controls the unfiltered-stereo or spread amount.

Properties.Title: Distance Unfiltered Stereo Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Maps listener distance to the amount of unfiltered stereo or spread used by the spatializer.

Properties.Title: Use Time Volume Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Enable the elapsed-time-to-volume curve.

Properties.Title: Time Volume Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Maps event elapsed time to a volume multiplier.

Properties.Title: Use Time Unfiltered Stereo Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Enable the elapsed-time curve controlling the unfiltered-stereo or spread amount.

Properties.Title: Time Unfiltered Stereo Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Maps event elapsed time to the amount of unfiltered stereo or spread.

Properties.Title: Use Doppler
Properties.Tooltip: Enable Doppler pitch shifting from relative source and listener motion.

Properties.Title: Use Velocity Volume Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Enable velocity-driven volume control using the Velocity Volume Curve.

Properties.Title: Velocity Volume Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Maps source or input velocity to a volume multiplier.

Properties.Title: Velocity Volume Seek Speed
Properties.Tooltip: Smoothing speed used when the velocity-driven volume value moves toward its target.

Properties.Title: Use Velocity Eq
Properties.Tooltip: Enable velocity-driven EQ or filter behavior in sound stacks that support it.

Properties.Title: Use Impact Speed Input Volume Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Enable the impact-speed-to-volume curve for physics-driven sounds.

Properties.Title: Impact Speed Input Volume Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Maps the supplied physics impact-speed input to a volume multiplier.

Properties.Title: Occlusion
Properties.Tooltip: Legacy or stack-specific occlusion toggle. For current csgo_mega behavior, Occlusion Intensity and Use Baked Occlusion are the clearer controls.

Properties.Title: Occlusion Intensity
Properties.Tooltip: Strength of geometry occlusion. 0 disables occlusion attenuation; 1 applies the full blocked-sound attenuation.

Properties.Title: Occlusion Frequency Scale
Properties.Tooltip: Scales the frequency-dependent part of occlusion, changing how strongly blocked sound is filtered.

Properties.Title: Occlusion Interval
Properties.Tooltip: Time interval, in seconds, between occlusion updates or traces.

Properties.Title: Use Baked Occlusion
Properties.Tooltip: Use baked occlusion or path data for this event instead of relying only on live occlusion behavior.

Properties.Title: Distance Effect Mix
Properties.Tooltip: Controls how much of the stack distance-effect processing is applied to the sound.

Properties.Title: Reverb Wet
Properties.Tooltip: Controls the environmental reverb wet amount used by the event sound stack.

Properties.Title: Reverb Source Wet
Properties.Tooltip: Controls the source-side wet amount used when the stack calculates the final reverb send.

Properties.Title: Restrict Source Reverb
Properties.Tooltip: Restrict how source-side reverb contributes to the final event reverb calculation.

Properties.Title: Dsp Preset
Properties.Tooltip: DSP or reverb preset to use when Override Dsp Preset is enabled.

Properties.Title: Override Dsp Preset
Properties.Tooltip: Use this event DSP Preset instead of the normal inherited or environment preset.

Properties.Title: Dsp Blend
Properties.Tooltip: Controls the blend used by the event DSP processing. Negative values can be used by stacks as a default or override state.

Properties.Title: Dsp Bypass
Properties.Tooltip: Routes the sound toward the DSP-bypass path instead of the normal processed or reverb paths.

Properties.Title: Enable Child Events
Properties.Tooltip: Allow this event to start the Soundevent 01 child event or child-event list.

Properties.Title: Soundevent 01
Properties.Tooltip: Child sound event name or list started by this event when Enable Child Events is enabled.

Properties.Title: Enable Retrigger
Properties.Tooltip: Enable periodic replay using Retrigger Interval Min/Max and the other retrigger settings.

Properties.Title: Retrigger Interval Min
Properties.Tooltip: Minimum delay in seconds before a retriggered event plays again.

Properties.Title: Retrigger Interval Max
Properties.Tooltip: Maximum delay in seconds before a retriggered event plays again.

Properties.Title: Retrigger Radius
Properties.Tooltip: Retrigger only while the listener is inside this radius. Values at or below 0 disable the radius requirement.

Properties.Title: Retrigger Count
Properties.Tooltip: Maximum number of retriggers when finite retriggering is used. -1 means unlimited.

Properties.Title: Instance Limit
Properties.Tooltip: Maximum number of matching event instances allowed by the limiter. 0 is commonly used when no explicit limit is wanted.

Properties.Title: Self Destruct Time
Properties.Tooltip: Automatically drives the event toward stop or fade after this many elapsed seconds. Negative values disable the timer.

Properties.Title: Stop At Time
Properties.Tooltip: Automatically stop this sound event when its elapsed time reaches this value in seconds. Negative values disable it.

Properties.Title: Block Matching Events
Properties.Tooltip: Block repeated instances of this same event according to Block Duration, Block Distance and Block Match Entity.

Properties.Title: Block Match Entity
Properties.Tooltip: When blocking matching events, require the source entity to match the current event source entity.

Properties.Title: Block Duration
Properties.Tooltip: How long, in seconds, a matching instance of this event is blocked after this event starts.

Properties.Title: Block Distance
Properties.Tooltip: Maximum spatial distance used when blocking matching instances. 0 commonly means no distance restriction.

Properties.Title: Block Other
Properties.Tooltip: Block other events whose names match Block Other Name, using the configured duration and distance.

Properties.Title: Block Other Name
Properties.Tooltip: Event-name substring matched by Block Other.

Properties.Title: Block Other Duration
Properties.Tooltip: How long, in seconds, events matched by Block Other Name are blocked.

Properties.Title: Block Other Distance
Properties.Tooltip: Maximum distance within which events matched by Block Other Name are blocked.

Properties.Title: Mixgroup
Properties.Tooltip: Mixer group used for event gain, routing and DSP behavior.

Properties.Title: Mixlayer Name
Properties.Tooltip: Name of a mixlayer targeted by setter-style sound-event types such as core_setter_AHR_mixlayer_amount.

Properties.Title: Set Mixlayer Layer
Properties.Tooltip: Name of the mixer layer whose amount is driven by Time Mixlayer Amount Curve.

Properties.Title: Set Mixlayer Amount Enable
Properties.Tooltip: Enable time-driven control of a named sound-mixer layer.

Properties.Title: Time Mixlayer Amount Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Maps event elapsed time to the amount applied to Set Mixlayer Layer.

Properties.Title: Use Volume Convar
Properties.Tooltip: Multiply event volume by the current value of Volume Convar.

Properties.Title: Volume Convar
Properties.Tooltip: Console variable whose current value scales the event volume.

Properties.Title: Loop Track
Properties.Tooltip: Loop or restart the selected music track. Endpoint and Restart Startpoint can define the loop boundary and restart position.

Properties.Title: Should Queue Track
Properties.Tooltip: Use the synchronized CS:GO music track queue instead of starting the track independently.

Properties.Title: Update Track Syncpoint Index
Properties.Tooltip: Store the selected music variation index globally and use its sync-point field when queueing, so related music events can stay aligned.

Properties.Title: Sync Action To Startround
Properties.Tooltip: Use the globally remembered StartRound track index so this music event selects the matching variation instead of a random track.

Properties.Title: Startpoint 01
Properties.Tooltip: Start or pre-roll time in seconds for music track 1 when it is started or queued.

Properties.Title: Startpoint 02
Properties.Tooltip: Start or pre-roll time in seconds for music track 2 when it is started or queued.

Properties.Title: Startpoint 03
Properties.Tooltip: Start or pre-roll time in seconds for music track 3 when it is started or queued.

Properties.Title: Endpoint 01
Properties.Tooltip: Optional loop or restart endpoint in seconds for music track 1. 0 lets the stack use the full VSND duration.

Properties.Title: Endpoint 02
Properties.Tooltip: Optional loop or restart endpoint in seconds for music track 2. 0 lets the stack use the full VSND duration.

Properties.Title: Endpoint 03
Properties.Tooltip: Optional loop or restart endpoint in seconds for music track 3. 0 lets the stack use the full VSND duration.

Properties.Title: Restart Startpoint 01
Properties.Tooltip: Time in seconds to restart music track 1 from when a loop or restart occurs.

Properties.Title: Restart Startpoint 02
Properties.Tooltip: Time in seconds to restart music track 2 from when a loop or restart occurs.

Properties.Title: Syncpoints 01
Properties.Tooltip: Ordered sync-point times, in seconds, for music track 1. The CS:GO music queue uses them to align transitions and related tracks.

Properties.Title: Syncpoints 02
Properties.Tooltip: Ordered sync-point times, in seconds, for music track 2. The CS:GO music queue uses them to align transitions and related tracks.

Properties.Title: Syncpoints 03
Properties.Tooltip: Ordered sync-point times, in seconds, for music track 3. The CS:GO music queue uses them to align transitions and related tracks.

Properties.Title: Stop Selection Music
Properties.Tooltip: Stop currently playing music events whose names begin with Music.Selection.

Properties.Title: Stop All Non Music
Properties.Tooltip: Stop matching non-Music sound events when this music event starts.

Properties.Title: Stop Music
Properties.Tooltip: Stop other sound events whose names begin with Music. when this event starts.

Properties.Title: Stop Match End
Properties.Tooltip: Stop currently playing Music.MatchEnd events.

Properties.Title: Stop Loading
Properties.Tooltip: Stop currently playing Music.LoadingScreen events.

Properties.Title: Join Non Mvp Group
Properties.Tooltip: Add this event to the non-MVP music group so Stop Music Except Mvp can stop it as a group.

Properties.Title: Priority Override
Properties.Tooltip: Make the music track queue use this event Priority value instead of the queue or default priority.

Properties.Title: Stop Start Round
Properties.Tooltip: Stop currently playing Music.StartRound events.

Properties.Title: Stop Tensec Count
Properties.Tooltip: Stop currently playing Music.TenSecCount events.

Properties.Title: Stop Bomb Planted
Properties.Tooltip: Stop currently playing Music.BombPlanted events.

Properties.Title: Stop Got Hostage
Properties.Tooltip: Stop currently playing Music.GotHostage events.

Properties.Title: Stop Music Except Mvp
Properties.Tooltip: Stop the shared non-MVP music group, leaving MVP music outside that group untouched.

Properties.Title: Skip If Muted
Properties.Tooltip: Do not start the music stack when its selected volume convar is effectively zero.

Properties.Title: Test Mvp Block
Properties.Tooltip: Check whether this MVP or music event is currently blocked before allowing it to play.

Properties.Title: Check For Classic Deathcam
Properties.Tooltip: If music or death-camera volume is effectively muted, start the classic Player.FreezeCam fallback sound event.

Properties.Title: Stop Won Mvp
Properties.Tooltip: Stop Music.WonRound, Music.LostRound and Music.MVPAnthem events. The current stack behavior is broader than the key name suggests.

Properties.Title: Block Won Lost
Properties.Tooltip: Create untimed blocks for Music.WonRound and Music.LostRound so those events cannot start while the block is active.

Properties.Title: Vsnd Files
Properties.Tooltip: VSND file or list used by csgo_music and related stacks. Multiple entries can be selected according to the stack selection rule.

Properties.Title: Vsnd Files Track 01
Properties.Tooltip: VSND file or list used by csgo_mega. When multiple files are supplied, the stack selects one for playback.

Properties.Title: Source Soundscape
Properties.Tooltip: Soundscape source referenced by the event stack.

Properties.Title: Uiposition
Properties.Tooltip: Listener-relative left/forward/up position vector. Paired with Use Uiposition.

Properties.Title: Use Distance Pitch Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Enables distance-based pitch mapping.

Properties.Title: Distance Pitch Mapping Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Maps listener distance to a pitch multiplier.

Properties.Title: Occlusion Path Curve
Properties.Tooltip: Baked-occlusion path curve used when Use Baked Occlusion is enabled.

Properties.Title: Doppler Factor
Properties.Tooltip: Doppler strength for approaching motion.

Properties.Title: Doppler Factor Receding
Properties.Tooltip: Doppler strength for receding motion.

Properties.Title: Impact Speed Input
Properties.Tooltip: Input value consumed by Impact Speed Input Volume Mapping Curve.

Properties.Title: Velocity Magnitude
Properties.Tooltip: Velocity input exposed by the current sound stack.

Properties.Title: Voice Fade Out Time
Properties.Tooltip: Voice-management fade time.

Properties.Title: Voice Looped Culling Update Time
Properties.Tooltip: Update interval for culling looped voices.

Properties.Title: Randomize Start Time
Properties.Tooltip: Randomizes the initial seek/start time within the VSND.

Properties.Title: Restart Startpoint 03
Properties.Tooltip: Third csgo_music restart startpoint, alongside Restart Startpoint 01 and 02.

Properties.Title: Retrigger Keepalive Override
Properties.Tooltip: Retrigger lifetime/keepalive override used by the csgo_mega stack.
